method: Per-gene standardised mean difference (viral - bacterial) on the log2 GPL96 expression matrix, cross-checked against the non-zero coefficients of the L1 logistic classifier. Markers below are the leading directional genes that are both differentially expressed and selected by the model.

signature_interpretation.viral: Type-I interferon / interferon-stimulated gene (ISG) program: IFI27, IFI44L, IFIT1/3, ISG15, MX1, OAS1/2/3, RSAD2, USP18, SIGLEC1. This is the canonical antiviral transcriptional signature expected in influenza A.
signature_interpretation.bacterial: Neutrophil / myeloid granule program: primary (ELANE, MPO, BPI, DEFA1/4), secondary (LTF, CAMP) and tertiary (MMP8) granule genes plus OLFM4 and PGLYRP1, consistent with neutrophil expansion and emergency granulopoiesis in pyogenic bacterial infection.
